source_quality.text_layer: usable prose; formula glyphs lost to legacy encoding and recovered from the page rasters

task_reconstruction: Prioritize the 17 SDGs from a data-driven network, say which are reachable within ten years, show how finishing one changes the order, answer crises, and carry the method to other users.

section_map.summary: summary: one paragraph per problem, closing with the three-part verdict
introduction: background, the gap in prior work, the objectives, the work list
six assumptions, each promised a justification, then the notation table
data: 169 targets, 241 indicators, 500 series, ten regions
the layered-network survey and the four-layer structure
the correlation cutoff and the three matrix products
the implementation vector, the clipping, and the matrix power
regional priorities and the decade forecast
finishing a goal turns its ties one-way
the shock equations and the perturbation table
the method carried to a firm with four aims
four robustness tests and the strengths and limits

contributions.summary: a goal adjacency obtained by multiplying up through four layers fixed by the official structure
a priority score read off a high power of that adjacency, so indirect chains count
a crisis written as one additive correction to the same network

assumptions.summary: knock-on effects are kept, and one example carries both a helpful and a harmful direction
the ties are stable, glossed as the network not changing over time
only linear ties are kept, because bent ones are common but hard to estimate
the influence between two targets is the same in both directions

data_and_preprocessing.summary: 169 targets and 241 indicators from the official study, 500 series from 1967 to 2018 across 263 countries
ten regions, with missing values filled, useless series dropped, then sorted and classified
a pair of series is linked only when the correlation exceeds 0.9 at significance below 0.1

models.summary: three layer products giving the indicator, target and goal adjacencies
one step, the matrix power, and the one-norm score
the shock rewrite, equations (1) to (5) plus the resistance form

verification.summary: the network is rebuilt for eight further regions to check that the ties differ
the regional priorities are called generally consistent with reality
four levers are varied and stability is claimed across all of them

results_trace.summary: in the world region three goals push fourteen others along and the seventeenth pulls against sixteen
inside ten years nine regions reach the first goal and only one reaches the climate, ocean, justice and partnership goals
after the fourth goal is finished the next priority is the eighth, then the seventeenth
natural disasters are read as the event that moves the order the most

writing_logic.summary: the summary answers the five problems in order, each paragraph opening with for problem
prior work is conceded, then limited twice: expert knowledge only, and no quantitative ordering
the shock findings close by assigning the reader a duty to weigh and to order

language_observations.summary: the goals are lifted above their function: not just a call to action, but a vision of hope
a restriction is conceded before it is imposed: although bent ties are widely present, we keep only the large ones
a revision is justified by the path it adds: not only the direct bearing, but the one through a third goal
the limit is confessed with its cost: leaving out the bent ties may cut what the model can catch

visualization_observations.summary: figure 6: the world network, orange-red for support, light-blue for antagonism, brightness for strength
figure 8: the direct edge beside the indirect chain, the reason the model was revised
figure 12: which goals ten regions can reach inside ten years
figure 16: the priority of each goal under six events

judge_relevance_hypotheses.summary: a judge looking for a usable plan gets a named priority per region, a decade count and a worked crisis
the priorities are checked against reality in prose, which is the only comparison a judge is offered

weaknesses.summary: the score norms the powered matrix while the prose describes powering the vector
clipping entries to between 0 and 1 erases the negative ties
equation (5) treats a 1 by 17 vector as invertible against a 17 by 17 identity
the correction is written as the inverse times the perturbation and as a coefficient times it
the perturbation entries are set by hand and the resistance coefficient has no value
the four robustness tests report no numbers
figure 15's caption names regional wars while the prose names natural disasters

independent_extensions.summary: the same layering carried to a firm with four aims: market, invention, profit and society, then offered to any body or person

unresolved_questions: why the score norms the powered matrix when the prose powers the vector
why entries are clipped to between 0 and 1 when the sign is the point of the network
why a 1 by 17 vector is called invertible
why equation (5) and the resistance line correct the network differently
why the perturbation entries are set by hand
why the resistance coefficient has no value
why the four robustness tests report no numbers
why figure 15's caption disagrees with the prose
